title: No Way To Steal My Face: Proactive Defense Against Identity-Preserving Personalized Generation
title_zh: IDGuardian：针对身份保留型个性化生成的主动防御

paragraphs.en: 《无法窃取我的面容：针对身份保留型个性化生成的主动防御》 Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled high-fidelity, identity-preserving image generation for personalized applications such as digital avatars and virtual try-on systems. However, their reliance on sensitive facial reference images raises growing privacy concerns. Existing defense mechanisms are primarily designed for training-based personalization and struggle to generalize to emerging training-free approaches, due to fundamental differences in their identity integration paradigms. To bridge this gap, we propose IDGuardian-the first generalizable and model-agnostic identity protection framework capable of defending against both training-based and training-free personalization methods. IDGuardian abstracts the personalization process into two critical stages: identity extraction and identity injection. It then introduces crafted adversarial perturbations to simultaneously disrupt both stages. Specifically, it degrades the identity features extracted by external encoders and establishes an adversarial conceptual bridge that misdirects the generative trajectory away from the target identity. Extensive experiments show that IDGuardian effectively protects identity across various personalization pipelines and model architectures, while remaining robust to post-processing, adaptive attacks, and cross-dataset generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenAscent-L/IDGuardian.git.
paragraphs.zh: 《无法窃取我的面容：针对身份保留型个性化生成的主动防御》扩散模型的最新进展已实现高保真、保留身份特征的图片生成，适用于数字虚拟形象与虚拟试穿系统等个性化应用。 然而，这些模型对敏感面部参考图像的依赖引发了日益严重的隐私担忧。 现有的防御机制主要面向基于训练的个性化方法设计，难以推广到新兴的无训练方法，这源于两者在身份整合范式上的根本差异。 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 IDGuardian——首个具备通用性和模型无关性的身份保护框架，能够同时抵御基于训练和无训练的个性化方法。 IDGuardian 将个性化过程抽象为两个关键阶段：身份提取与身份注入。 随后，它通过引入精心设计的对抗性扰动，同步破坏这两个阶段。 具体而言，它会削弱外部编码器提取的身份特征，并构建一个对抗性概念桥梁，使生成轨迹偏离目标身份。 大量实验表明，IDGuardian 能有效保护各类个性化流程与模型架构中的身份特征，同时对后处理、自适应攻击和跨数据集泛化保持鲁棒性。 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/OpenAscent-L/IDGuardian.git 获取。
